findings.quoted_finding: The proposed item 6 disclosure says interactions are standardized over the estimation panel.
defect_evidence: The producer reads the full synth_data target (1,920 rows, 96 countries, 1997-2016), constructs and standardizes interactions before sdid_fit_spec(panel, cols) filters to its default 1997-2015 fit (1,824 rows).

Arithmetic check: the full standardized primary interaction has mean approximately zero and SD 1; restricting that same vector to the fitted rows gives mean 0.01186477 and SD 1.024619. Thus the reported standardization population is inaccurate.
mechanical_checks: Read-only R reconstruction of primary exposure times the 2008-2009 indicator from stored panel and archived exposure CSV; no fit. See precision_checks in this JSON.
findings.reasoning: This is a source-verified defect in the proposed explanatory wording, not evidence of a wrong ATT. The moving candidate was seen to contain similar wording, but final candidate persistence/location is explicitly unadjudicated until integration_final.txt exists.
findings.disposition: At final integration, describe standardization over the stored 1997-2016 input panel before restriction to the 1997-2015 estimation window; apply equally to the price interaction. Text only; no reestimation or pipeline change.

findings.quoted_finding: The absolute power gap is not mechanically collinear with country power and time effects; its nonzero stored coefficient supports separate identification.
refuting_evidence: All 1,824 fitted country-years have raw country GPI <= U.S. GPI and gap = U.S. GPI - country GPI exactly; all 13 stored X columns and Y match the stored panel in fitted row/year order.
With separately affinely rescaled columns, X_gap + 0.8451679 X_gpi is year-only to 9.44e-16. Its projections in the actual lambda and omega objectives are zero to 4.88e-16 and 3.61e-16.

The package jointly updates weights and nuisance beta and forms the final contrast on Y-contract3(X,beta). Both intercept flags are TRUE. A time-only shift is annihilated by this parameterization. Nonzero beta_gap=-0.008069458 therefore does not establish an independent effect.
The preferred fit has X dimension 96 x 19 x 0 and ATT -0.272771407583060; direct fixed-weight reconstruction has zero discrepancy.

findings.disposition: Do not restore the rejected noncollinearity/independent-effect claim. Preserve the preferred no-covariate fit. Final candidate wording remains to be checked after integration.

bounded_source_checks.evidence: Current five-year restricted risk set: 35 treated; archived audit matrix: 14, of whom 13 current, Qatar noncurrent, 22 current unaudited. Display has nine unknown-China-cue cases. Original filter retains nonobserved cues plus Australia. Definitions traced through China-cue counted() and explicit manual Qatar code, and incumbent countable()/medium rules; no new search.

Original retrieval queries china, chronological sort, extracts title/timestamp. Classification producer deduplicates title, filters China/chines variants, specifies gpt-4.1-mini temperature 0, code-defined slices, parser and exact-title join, brasil-to-brazil normalization. This is code configuration, not historical run provenance; the loop does not itself certify complete archived coverage. Archived classified file: 14,589 unique titles and stored model alias. Validation: 100 records, 88% unweighted agreement; six predicted trade records all agree. Category-conditioned agreement does not identify corpus recall, inclusion probabilities or temporal stability. No new metric is approved for manuscript inclusion.

2004-2008 country-mean exposure shares of external goods; 2008-2009 interaction indicator; price log changes relative to 2007 weighted by Agriculture/Energy/Metals shares; only time-varying interactions in diagnostic specs. Source excludes domestic flows and Services. Lower-order fixed exposure and common indicator are absorbed. Standardization-population correction RM-S006.

Same 95 donors, separate weight fitting; post horizons 6,5,4,7,5; late nominal pre includes 2009-2011. Existing point estimates do not provide inference for cross-window contrasts or a common estimand.

se_sdid forms finite-population SD of donor-only seeded placebo resamples; normal p/CI then use this SE. SE 0.13060794328219072, 20,000, seed 20260520. Exhaustive archived ranks independently reproduce 3/96 and 7/96. Main donor and pre-time weights sum to one, may be zero; full treated/post objective weights are positive 1 and 1/7. Direct ATT contrast equals -0.272771407583060. collapsed.form and lambda branch use controls pre and post; omega branch uses pretreatment paths. Plot producer consumes the preferred no-covariate fit; level-adjusted ATT differs conceptually from raw vertical gap. No new image render.

Original producer scores no/abstain/yes -1/0/1, builds distance-to-China minus distance-to-USA, excludes invalid own/reference votes, flags differing China/USA scores. Corrected DDD uses country+resolution FE with Brazil-post, Brazil-domain, triple interaction, equal observed vote weights.

Stored four cells all 4,727 rows and 10,000 bootstraps. Within-scale r2-r1 changes -0.059345646431 BSV and -0.038020234148 UNGA-DM; different changes demonstrate descriptive nonadditivity, not a tested interaction. Paired stored draws reconcile to percentile p=.134/.356; shared draws, factor counts fixed within replicates (CV=FALSE). Raw cross-source differences are scale dependent; nonrejection is not equivalence.

Read stored separate BRA/CHN ideal-point values around 2009 and figure-producing chunk. China has sizable annual oscillations, while Brazilian movement toward China persists over 2009-2012. No variance attribution was computed or validated; narrowed period-average description is supported.

Reviewed four proposed audit targets/schema/validation rules only. Required retained/omitted actual-year lists must not fill unobserved gaps; retained keys reconcile with restricted risk set. Proposal remains unimplemented, with table and caption conditioned on target output. No item15 computations were run.
